metadata.name: H1 · the head loop: identification babble on the four head commands (walker holds the body)
metadata.description: Playroom plan, the H line (2026-09-10). The same module code as the twist brain with four command dimensions: neck_pitch, head_pitch, head_yaw, head_roll as deltas from HOME in the walker's command vector (robot.head on the robot). Senses: the head's own joint positions in command units (the 'joints'), and 12 load slots = head roll, head pitch, head down-shortfall | head gyro x,y,z | trunk gravity x,y | trunk gyro x,y,z | 1 spare. H1: babble_ticks 30000 (600 s), hold 25 ticks (0.5 s — the walker's head low-pass answers in ~10), scale 0.3 of the trained ranges (±0.33 rad pitch), prior off. The H1 gate is the identified A: the position diagonal positive and dominant; the pitches on head-gravity x; roll on head-gravity y. H2 turns the prior on (slots 12,13 = head roll, pitch (load slots 0,1 = head-gravity y, z) -> 0: level).
